physicalNotes: Radius 1.28 Jupiter radii from Boisse et al. 2013 (2013A&A...558A..86B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A%26A...558A..86B/abstract): 91,509.8 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 1.044 Jupiter masses (Boisse et al. 2013, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2013A&A...558A..86B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A%26A...558A..86B/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
